provenance.dimension_basis: OEM family dimensions; video-estimated bezel, liner mouth, sheet thickness and handle shape. Serial revision not legible.
provenance.hidden_structure: Sheet thickness, rail internals, counterbalance, latch linkage and rear service detail are visual engineering estimates, not recovered OEM internals. Rear recess depth estimated; width64mm from OEM drawing.

review.method: Inspected final H264-decoded paired source/output samples at closed product, LCD/USB macro and open/moving door states. Full streams were decoded and counted; visual inspection is sampled, not every frame.
findings: Principal AOC upright envelope, lower control strip, upper two-column vents and vertical hatch arrangement reviewed against original source.
Dense motion samples confirm the source closing/opening timing; source cuts are not interpolated into invented movements.
Corrected native hatch/handle assembly has no evaluated surface intersections with cabinet, fixed vent, louver lips or rails at11 travel samples.
Final paired H264 streams decode to expected count and dimensions; localized source LED emission material stays on the native front-facing display.
Cavity floor meets the front throat; isolated hidden internal components remain engineering estimates.
limitations: Only principal microwave geometry and visible mechanical states are reconstructed. Source people, food, overlaid titles and editing transitions are omitted.
Camera landmark fits and interpolated source tracking remain estimates; per-frame source indices and native projection equivalence do not prove pixel-perfect visual reconstruction.
Hidden joints, seals, latches, wall thicknesses and unmeasured local dimensions are estimated; no force simulation or continuous-time collision certification.

Source pixels are limited to rectified approved visible LCD emission surfaces. All cabinet, door and controls are native geometry; occluded LCD states use native text or a reliable unchanged display state.

AOC family envelope is supported by OEM specifications; exact production revision, internal counterbalance, seal/latch and sheet thickness remain estimates. The older cavity depth254mm differs from a later usable-depth216mm specification.
Only emitted green LCD glyph pixels are retained; inactive gray segment appearance and printed status details are simplified.
Local camera fits on occluded or cropped cavities remain approximate, including inferred rear-wall depth.
Factory rear appearance is retained as a closed production-shell approximation. Source unassembled internal production detail is not reproduced.
Factory rear camera is behind the fixed kitchen return wall: only that wall camera-ray visibility is disabled for this shot. Geometry, lights, shadows, reflections and asset anchor are unchanged.
Overhead edited inset is represented by its principal appliance camera; the background video layer is not another physical viewpoint.

native_projection.method: bpy_extras world_to_camera_view for native LCD 3D corners versus per-source camera K/matrix used by material homography
